name: sports-coaching
summary: Coaches teach a sport or fitness, one on one or in groups.
description: Coaching is in person or online, paid by the session, the hour or a pack of sessions; the student is whoever arranges the coaching, often a parent, who stays present for a child's session in person. Desk subjects and chess are tutoring.

description.description: The coaching, in the writer's words: what is taught, how, and for whom.

price.description: Each price, what each person pays, for a group their own share: per hour or per session, with a count for a pack, such as 10 sessions, or with no per for a whole course; in a request, the most the student would pay.

sports.description: The sports taught; football is soccer, hockey is field hockey, and fitness is strength and conditioning, as a personal trainer teaches.

levels.description: The levels the coaching is for, each one; all levels is every value.

ages.description: The learners' ages, in years: in an offer, the ages coached, such as 9 to 11, or 18 and over; in a request, the learner's age, or each learner's, as the youngest to the oldest.

groupSize.description: How many learners in one session, not counting the coach: 1 for one on one, or the fewest and the most, such as 4 to 8; in a request, the group sizes the student would join, such as 1 to 4.

minutes.description: How long one session lasts, or the shortest and the longest, such as 45 to 90.

mode.description: How sessions are held: online, in person, or both.

place.description: Where sessions can be held in person: in an offer, a club, a court, or the area the coach will go to; in a request, where the student is or will go.

hours.description: When sessions can be held, each week.

paid.description: Whether the student paid as agreed.
